description:
24/7 AI Agent Memory & Configuration Monitor (ZK-MIM) & Sovereign Dual-Pulse (`<2ms` Kernel Breach Tripwire + `60s` Heartbeat) — included on **Agent Sentinel ($39/mo · 10–21 Armed Watches)** and **Sovereign Command ($399/mo · 64+ Armed Watches)**.
- `action: 'discover'`: `<80ms` local scan detecting Claude Code & Desktop, Gemini CLI & Antigravity, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Qwen Code, Kimi Code, OpenClaw, Grok Build, Windsurf, and Cline / Roo / Aider constitutions (`CLAUDE.md`, `SOUL.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `settings.json`, `mcp_config.json`, `.cursor/rules`, `.mcp.json`) and memory streams (`MEMORY.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `brain/`, `memory/`) with recommended `vault_lock` vs `auto_seal` modes.
- `action: 'arm'` / `action: 'arm_batch'`: Establishes Baseline Seal (1 unified State-Spine credit per directory in `<150ms`), spawns persistent 24/7 background Watch daemon (`<2ms` detection), and streams zero-knowledge 60s heartbeats to `/dashboard`. `mode: 'vault_lock'` locks static constitutions/configs; `mode: 'auto_seal'` uses **Close-of-Day Seal** + 14-day `~/.reltime/snapshots/` rollback backups.
- `action: 'status'`: Lists all armed Watches, live Dual-Pulse status, snooze timers, pending daily seals, and breach incidents.
- `action: 'snooze'` / `action: 'resume'`: Pauses alert popups while actively editing (`snooze_duration`: `'15m'`, `'1h'`, `'4h'`, or `'end_of_day'`) after Hardware Touch ID / Secure Enclave approval, or resumes & re-seals immediately.
- `action: 'seal_now'`: Immediately checkpoints any pending daily memory edits or in-flight session logs to Bitcoin L1 on demand.
- `action: 'restore_snapshot'`: Lists or restores a verified local rollback copy (`~/.reltime/snapshots/<watch_id>/`) of `MEMORY.md` / `GEMINI.md`.
- `action: 'resolve'`: Acknowledges an authorized edit after Hardware Touch ID / Secure Enclave verification, re-seals modified files, and clears the tamper alert.
- `action: 'disarm'`: Stops the 24/7 background Watch daemon after Hardware Touch ID / Secure Enclave verification.

action.description: Watch command: 'discover' (scan local agents), 'arm', 'arm_batch', 'status', 'snooze' (biometric-gated edit pause), 'resume', 'seal_now', 'restore_snapshot', 'resolve', or 'disarm'.

biometric.description: If true (default when a Passkey is linked), binds baseline and auto-sealed anchors to your Hardware Passkey (`~/.reltime/passkey.json`).

cadence.description: For 'auto_seal': 'close_of_day' (default — seals finished daily/session logs and evolving MEMORY.md checkpoints at day rollover with 0 mid-day false alerts) or 'instant' (immediately anchors and locks every new dropbox file the second it appears).

confirm_restore.description: Set true to write the selected `snapshot_file` back to its guarded file path.

extra_roots.description: Optional extra project/workspace folder paths to include when action is 'discover'.

mode.description: 'auto_seal' (Close-of-Day Seal for agent memory logs & evolving MEMORY.md) or 'vault_lock' (strict static lock for CLAUDE.md, SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, .env, .mcp.json).

snapshot_file.description: Optional snapshot filename from `restore_snapshot` listing; when provided with `confirm_restore: true`, restores that verified backup over the memory file and re-seals.

snooze_duration.description: Used when action is 'snooze': duration to pause alerts ('15m', '1h', '4h', or 'end_of_day' until 11:59 PM local time; defaults to '1h'). Auto-reseals to Bitcoin when snooze finishes.

target_path.description: Local directory or file path to guard 24/7 (required for 'arm'; optional for 'snooze'/'resume'/'resolve'/'disarm'/'seal_now'/'restore_snapshot').

targets.description: Used when action is 'arm_batch': array of `{ target_path: string, mode?: 'vault_lock' | 'auto_seal' }` objects to arm in one call.

name: reltime_watch
